title: Purple Oni Fighter
description: Two side-by-side poses of a stylized purple and white oni-like character with horns, sharp teeth, and a skull-adorned outfit. The figure wears a white and purple patterned gi with flowing sashes, black gloves, and sandals, striking dynamic martial arts stances against a plain gray background.
prompt: A fierce purple-skinned oni demon with white hair, curved horns, and glowing eyes, wearing a white and purple swirling patterned gi with skull belt and purple sash, black fingerless gloves, and traditional sandals. The character has a small white fox-like mask on his shoulder and holds a skull in one hand while striking two different dynamic martial arts fighting poses, shown in two nearly identical views side by side, clean anime-inspired 2D illustration style on solid gray background.
